result.reason: The clause includes the required annual limit, 30 days’ written notice, business-hours restriction, independent confidential auditor, and prohibition on system access. However, cost shifting applies to any “discrepancy” over 5%, rather than specifically an underpayment exceeding 5%, so it does not fully reach the preferred position. The cost paragraph was also unnecessarily moved before subsection (b), creating avoidable structural ambiguity. The margin comment’s reference to an off-site audit is not reflected in the operative language and is not the stated playbook requirement.
